description_en: Retrieves a list of databases in a data lake
description_zh: 调用此API可以获取数据湖的数据库列表
name: ListDataLakeDatabase

parameters.help_en: The name of the catalog. To find the catelog name, go to the Data Lake console (https://dlf.console.aliyun.com/cn-hangzhou/metadata/catalog?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.5a225658pT4Dkr)
parameters.help_zh: 查询的数据目录名称。您可前往数据湖控制台 (https://dlf.console.aliyun.com/cn-hangzhou/metadata/catalog?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.5a225658pT4Dkr)查看数据目录名称
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en: A keyword to search for database names
parameters.help_zh: 搜索数据库名称的关键字
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

Hover over your profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console to obtain the tenant ID. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no more results are available.

If NextToken has a value, it is the token for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100
parameters.name: max_results

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page. This parameter is used with \`NextToken\` for paging
MaxResults.description_zh: 限定每次返回的最大条数，可以和NextToken搭配使用实现翻页能力

NextToken.description_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. If this parameter is empty, no more results are available
NextToken.description_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
